interactions.label: NOODLE COUNTER
interactions.dialog: MAMA ROO'S. THE BROTH HAS BEEN ON SINCE BEFORE THE DISTRICT WAS BUILT ON TOP OF IT.

interactions.label: MAMA ROO
interactions.dialog: MAMA ROO STIRS THE POT.

interactions.label: BRICK
interactions.dialog: BRICK LOOKS AT YOU. JUST LOOKS.

interactions.label: TALLY
interactions.dialog: TALLY CHALKS UP THE ODDS.

interactions.label: GAGE
interactions.dialog: GAGE WIPES HIS HANDS.

interactions.label: LIFT
interactions.prompt: PRESS E TO CALL THE LIFT

interactions.label: LIFT
interactions.prompt: PRESS E TO CALL THE LIFT

interactions.label: HOLO KIOSK
interactions.dialog: AN AD FOR THE SKYWALK, TWO HUNDRED FLOORS UP: BLUE SKY, GLASS, A WOMAN LAUGHING. SOMEONE HAS SCRATCHED 'NOT FOR YOU' ACROSS THE LENS.

interactions.label: DRUM FIRE
interactions.dialog: AN OIL DRUM, A FIRE IN IT, HANDS HELD OUT TO IT. NOBODY ASKS YOUR NAME. SOMEONE MOVES UP TO MAKE ROOM.

interactions.label: SLEEPER
interactions.dialog: SOMEONE ASLEEP UNDER A BLANKET, A RADIO PLAYING SOFTLY BESIDE THEM. THE STATION IS ONE FROM UP TOP: THE WEATHER FOR THE DISTRICT. RAIN, IT SAYS. IT IS ALWAYS RAIN DOWN HERE.

interactions.label: VENDING MACHINE
interactions.dialog: IT SELLS ONE THING: CANS OF "AIR - UP TOP FRESH". THEY ARE EMPTY. THEY ARE SOLD OUT.

interactions.label: SLEEPER
interactions.dialog: A MAN ASLEEP ON A MATTRESS BY THE DUMPSTER, ONE ARM CHROME TO THE SHOULDER, THE CHROME TWITCHING IN HIS SLEEP.

interactions.label: NOODLE STALL
interactions.dialog: NOODLES.

interactions.label: DUMPLING STALL
interactions.dialog: DUMPLINGS.

interactions.label: SKEWER STALL
interactions.dialog: SKEWERS.

interactions.label: TEA STALL
interactions.dialog: TEA.

interactions.label: DRINKS STALL
interactions.dialog: DRINKS.

interactions.label: JUNK STALL
interactions.dialog: CABLES, CHARGERS, A BOX OF LOOSE KEYS FOR NOTHING IN PARTICULAR, A ROBOT HAND IN A JAR. THE STALLHOLDER IS ASLEEP.

interactions.label: GRILL STALL
interactions.dialog: THE GRILL.

interactions.label: TEA HOUSE
interactions.dialog: A DOORWAY UNDER TWO LANTERNS, A CURTAIN, OLD MEN INSIDE OVER LITTLE CUPS. ONE LOOKS UP, SEES YOU ARE NOT FROM HERE, AND LOOKS BACK DOWN.

interactions.label: CURRY STALL
interactions.dialog: CURRY.

interactions.label: PAWN
interactions.dialog: WATCHES, RINGS, A TRUMPET, A HUNDRED PHONES, A WEDDING DRESS IN A BAG. "WE BUY," SAYS THE SIGN. "WE DON'T SELL TO YOU," SAYS THE MAN.

interactions.label: MAHJONG DEN
interactions.dialog: THE CLACK OF TILES, SMOKE, A SHOUT. FOUR PLAYERS, NONE OF WHOM HAS SLEPT SINCE THE WEEK BEFORE LAST.

interactions.label: CAPSULE HOSTEL
interactions.dialog: PODS STACKED IN THE WALL, FIVE COINS A NIGHT, A CURTAIN FOR A DOOR. MOST ARE TAKEN. SOMEONE IS SNORING IN THREE OF THEM AT ONCE.

interactions.label: MEDS COUNTER
interactions.dialog: MEDS.

interactions.label: HAWKER STALL
interactions.dialog: FOOD.

interactions.label: NOODLE STALL
interactions.dialog: NOODLES.

interactions.label: KTV
interactions.dialog: THROUGH THE PINK GLASS: SIX PEOPLE IN A BOX SINGING A LOVE SONG, BADLY, WITH THEIR WHOLE HEARTS.

interactions.label: BURNT CAR
interactions.dialog: A HOVER CAR'S SHELL, BURNT OUT AND STRIPPED TO THE FRAME. 'SAINTS' IS SPRAYED ACROSS THE HOOD IN ORANGE.

interactions.label: BANNER
interactions.dialog: THE RUST SAINTS: AN ORANGE HALO OVER A WRENCH. THIS SIDE OF THE FENCE IS THEIRS, AND THEY WILL TELL YOU SO.

interactions.label: TURF
interactions.dialog: ORANGE PAINT ON THE FLOOR AT THE GAP IN THE FENCE: A CROWN OF THREE STROKES. PAST IT, THE RUST SAINTS' TURF. PAST THAT, THE SCRAPYARDS.
